title: UAT-17: external counsel sees the shared revision, downloads the private original and sends one reviewed spending request to Finance
proof: Ordinary external identity sees only explicitly shared immutable versions and no internal comments; external counsel downloads the exact private PDF bytes pinned by document checksum/version, and the owner evidence export records one portal.download for that actor/document. A revoked share denies another download without adding a download event; another recipient sees no private billing; one repeated billing receipt creates exactly one reviewed Finance spending request.

title: UAT-18: cyclic evidence links retain both holds and releasing one preserves the other original
proof: Native cyclic evidence links carry two overlapping holds; author cannot release their own hold; independent release leaves one hold on both records; native delete and replacement attempts fail and original SHA256 remains unchanged.

title: UAT-20/21: independently reviewed fixture revisions respect dates and conflicts and open exact authorized citations
